description: This file defines the class ListViewDataEmailsSearchOnIMap, which extends ListViewDataEmailsSearchAbstract. It provides a 'search' method that interacts with an email server to retrieve emails via IMAP with pagination, filters emails by mailbox ID, and prepares data for displaying email list views in the application. The class is specific to handling email data with IMAP integration within a CRM module.

classes.name: ListViewDataEmailsSearchOnIMap
classes.description: A class extending ListViewDataEmailsSearchAbstract, providing IMAP-based email search and pagination functionalities for the email list view in the CRM module.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a paginated search of emails from an IMAP email server, applies filtering based on mailbox ID, and prepares the data for display. Handles sorting, pagination offsets, URL generation, and search form processing.

methods.name: retrieveEmailAssignedUser
methods.description: Retrieves and returns the assigned user information (user ID and username) associated with a specific email UID.
